faq.question: What helps a Be-Tech compatibility request move fastest?
faq.answer: The fastest requests usually include a current card sample or a clear Be-Tech lock or system reference along with notes on printing, encoding and any material preference.

faq.question: Should Be-Tech hotels jump straight to upgraded materials?
faq.answer: Usually no. It is safer to validate the baseline compatible card path first, then add upgraded material options once the estate fit is already proven.
